VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims to have fixed the issue and run all 58 tests successfully, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or other artifacts) to corroborate these claims. Self-reports are the weakest form of evidence and cannot independently validate that the fix was actually implemented correctly or that tests genuinely passed.
